purpose: The n=35 primary cohort left referee_vs_naive at achieved power 0.59 against a requirement of 56 discordant pairs. This cohort is a superset of those 35 cases and exists only to power that one contrast. It does not replace any primary number.

comparison_to_primary.read: The effect replicates at 0.250 against 0.257 and the interval tightens from [0.029, 0.486] to [0.113, 0.375], so the primary estimate was accurate but under-powered rather than wrong.
